daily_accounting.note: Daily marked trading P&L, including today's closed trades. Fees, dividends, transfers, unassigned assets and sampling differences remain in the unallocated account change; not guaranteed net profit.

account_history.note: Daily account equity change, not guaranteed realized profit. Includes holdings' price changes and may include transfers or other account adjustments. First funded observation is a baseline. Partial fills count as separate executions. Past portfolio attribution and historical open-position lists are not reconstructed.
